enderportals.book.page1:
§5The Offering§0

The player has the Overworld, and beneath the Overworld, the Nether.

The Enderman has the End, and beneath the End, the §5Ender§0.

When an Enderman lifts a block, it is not stealing it. It is carrying it away to be given up.
enderportals.book.page2:
§5The Paradise of Cubes§0

What is given up reaches the Ender: an endless cavern where undone matter sleeps, caught in a grey translucent mass.

Your door does not open onto a new world. It opens onto theirs.
enderportals.book.page3:
§5The Mass§0

No cave, no tunnel: the Ender is solid from end to end. You only move through it by carving your own gallery.

Through the grey you glimpse the §7relics§0 in diffuse clouds. Rare violet veins are the only landmarks — and the only light.
enderportals.book.page4:
§5The Ore§0

An ancient ore surfaces in the End's stone. Its §bcrystals§0 hum with the rhythm of the vortex.

An iron pickaxe is enough to harvest them. Fortune yields more.
enderportals.book.page5:
§5The Dormant Door§0

Craft (bench):
§5O O O§0
§5O §bC §6★§0
§5O O O§0

§5O§0 = Crying Obsidian
§bC§0 = Ender Crystal
§6★§0 = Nether Star

Place it anywhere. It sleeps.
enderportals.book.page6:
§5The Ritual§0

Only a colossal impact can awaken it.

Take a §cMace§0, climb at least §c20 blocks§0, jump — and strike the door mid-air.

The impact will absorb your fall. Lightning will do the rest.
enderportals.book.page7:
§5The Key§0

Craft (vertical):
§bCrystal§0
§3Ender Pearl§0
§6Gold Ingot§0

Right-click the air: the key binds to §5your§0 door.
Right-click the ground: the door materialises.
On the door: open, then dematerialise.

It answers to you alone.

enderportals.book.page8:
§5The Ender Pickaxe§0

Craft: 3 crystals in a row, 2 sticks.

It alone can carve §7Ender Blocks§0, shattering them like glass.

4 crystals = 1 Block
4 Blocks = 4 Bricks, translucent like it. Stairs, slabs, wall and a chiselled brick follow.
enderportals.book.page9:
§5Your pocket base§0

Behind the door: your plot, carved out of the endless cavern.

§aBeds§0 work and set your respawn there. §cAnchors§0 do not: they explode. No Nether portal will light.

One door per person.
enderportals.book.page10:
§5The Way Out§0

If someone builds on the very spot where your door slept, you are not trapped.

Click the inner door: it settles nearby, or failing that at your respawn point — and gives you the coordinates.

enderportals.book.page11:
§5The Item Transmitter§0

Craft (bench):
§7I §4R §7I§0
§7I §5E §7I§0
§7I §7I §7I§0

§7I§0 = Iron Block
§4R§0 = Redstone Block
§5E§0 = Ender Chest

Place it in your base and attach your storage: block to block, the network grows.
enderportals.book.page12:
§5The Ender Bag§0

Craft: a bundle and an ender chest.

In your §boffhand§0, right-click: the top row of your inventory flies into your base's network, wherever you are.

Each stored slot costs a little §aXP§0.
enderportals.book.page13:
§5The Great Network§0

The Transmitter speaks the common tongue of storage: barrels, backpacks — Sophisticated, Tom's — all answer, and filters sort on their own.

Stick it to a Tom's Inventory Connector: the Bag pours into the whole network, counted right.
enderportals.book.page14:
§5The Allies' Passage§0

Craft (bench):
§7Q §bC §7Q§0
§bC §5E §bC§0
§7Q §bC §7Q§0

§7Q§0 = Quartz Block
§bC§0 = Ender Crystal
§5E§0 = Ender Chest

Place it in the Ender, with a §6Friendship Control§0 flush against it.
enderportals.book.page15:
§5The Friend Code§0

Your key carries an eight-digit code. Read it out, type the other's on the panel: you are friends.

Then click their name, let them click yours, and both passages open. You cross them either way, even while one of you is away.
